approach: Direct simulation subtracting 2 from position per second.
observation: Each second, 2 people ahead of any position greater than 3 leave the queue (position 1 and position 3). Thus your effective 1-based queue index drops by 2.
bruteForce: Simulate queue array removal element by element. O(N) space and time.
optimalSolution: Loop while position > 0: increment seconds. If position == 1 or position == 3, return seconds. Subtract 2 from position. If position <= 0, return -1. Time complexity O(N).
dryRun: N = 5. sec 1: pos 5!=1,3 -> pos=3. sec 2: pos=3 -> return 2.
